what changed: Otsu threshold on blurred grayscale, bright class = egg
why tried: Simplest possible baseline; eggs are usually brighter than their surroundings.

what changed: HSV 'white' mask: saturation < 60 and value > 140
why tried: Eggs are low-saturation/white, which a grayscale threshold ignores.

what changed: Lab colour distance from the median border colour + Otsu
why tried: Handles non-white backgrounds and dark eggs: foreground = 'whatever differs from the image border'.

what changed: GrabCut initialised with a centred rectangle (12% margin)
why tried: Exploits the prior that the egg is roughly centred; GrabCut models colour distributions.

what changed: Candidate components from otsu/hsv/border generators, ranked by an egg-likeness score (ellipse fit, solidity, contrast, whiteness, border penalty)
why tried: Single thresholds fail whenever the background is bright/dark or textured; selecting by shape picks the right blob regardless of which generator found it.

what changed: Add Canny-enclosed-region candidates
why tried: Edge-bounded regions can isolate an egg when its colour is close to the background.

what changed: Raise threshold for accepting additional eggs (0.6 -> 0.75)
why tried: Reduce false extra detections that lower precision.

what changed: Lower threshold for accepting additional eggs (-> 0.5)
why tried: Opposite direction: recover missed eggs in multi-egg images.

what changed: Remove the whiteness prior (w_white 0.10 -> 0)
why tried: Test whether the 'eggs are white' assumption hurts brown/shadowed eggs.

what changed: GrabCut boundary refinement seeded from the selected mask
why tried: Thresholded blobs have rough or leaked boundaries; GrabCut snaps them to image edges.

what changed: Give GrabCut more freedom (smaller sure core, wider search band)
why tried: If the first mask is too small or too large, a wider band lets GrabCut correct it.

what changed: Replace a component by its best-fit ellipse when IoU(component, ellipse) >= 0.85
why tried: SAM masks are smooth, near-elliptical outlines; regularising removes jagged boundaries and dents.

what changed: Stronger morphological opening/closing (kernel 7 -> 11)
why tried: Remove thin protrusions (fingers, shadows) attached to the egg.

what changed: Ellipse search: find the ellipse (centre, axes, angle) whose boundary has the strongest inside/outside colour contrast; up to 3 eggs; mask = the ellipse itself
why tried: Phase 1 segmented colour *regions* and leaked into similar surroundings. Eggs are ellipses, so search for the outline directly instead.

what changed: Stricter acceptance of 2nd/3rd eggs: score >= 0.85x best and area >= 0.35x best
why tried: E01 added false extra 'eggs' (background blobs) in single-egg images, which hurts precision.

what changed: Raise minimum egg size (7% -> 10% of image side) and use a finer centre grid
why tried: E01/E02 errors: tiny ellipses on small rocks / cords / pattern edges beat the real egg on textured backgrounds.

what changed: Penalise texture inside the ellipse (w_int = 0.2)
why tried: Eggs have smooth surfaces; background clutter and bowl ripples do not. (Larger weights were tried informally and hurt.)

what changed: Relax the 'egg is brighter than its surroundings' prior (dark_w 0.7 -> 0.85)
why tried: Shadowed, brown or hand-held dark eggs have inside darker than outside; the prior was too strict for them.

what changed: Refine each ellipse with GrabCut (sure-foreground = 55% ellipse, search band = 135% ellipse; fall back to the ellipse if GrabCut leaks)
why tried: Real eggs are not perfect ellipses; GrabCut snaps the boundary to image edges, but only inside the ellipse so it cannot leak far.

what changed: Run GrabCut at 320 px instead of 160 px
why tried: Boundary accuracy: 160 px masks are blocky after upsampling.

what changed: Extra eggs must also have similar colour (dLab < 30), not overlap the first egg, and score >= 0.9x
why tried: Multi-egg photos contain eggs of the same colour; false extras are different (cloth, hand, shadows) or just overlap the real egg.

what changed: Segment only the single best egg
why tried: Check how much the multi-egg logic helps or hurts overall; most images contain one egg.

what changed: Constrain GrabCut more (core 0.65, band 1.25, leak guard IoU 0.75)
why tried: Reduce leaks into similar-coloured neighbours (cords, rims) at the cost of less freedom.

what changed: Union the GrabCut mask with the 85%-scaled ellipse
why tried: GrabCut sometimes drops shadowed parts inside the egg; the ellipse core is almost always egg.

what changed: Morphological open/close (7 px) + hole filling on the GrabCut mask
why tried: Remove thin protrusions and holes.

what changed: Lower the per-point contrast cap (35 -> 15)
why tried: One very sharp edge (text on a bag, a tray bar) can dominate the mean boundary contrast; a lower cap stops it outvoting the real egg outline.

what changed: Weight the 25th-percentile contrast more than the mean (w_mean 0.5 -> 0.2)
why tried: Demand contrast along the whole outline, not just a strong part of it, so partial edges on distractors score lower.

what changed: Penalise 'inside darker than outside' harder (dark_w 0.7 -> 0.3)
why tried: E05 showed relaxing the brightness prior hurt (0.85); go the other way. Distractors such as shadows and dark gaps are dark-inside ellipses.

what changed: Size prior: minimum semi-axis 10% -> 12% of image side and add a reward for larger ellipses (w_size 0 -> 1.0)
why tried: Worst dev cases picked tiny ellipses. Task 1 egg sizes (semi-axis / image side): min 0.121, 5th pct 0.143, median 0.227, so anything much smaller than ~0.12 cannot be an egg.

what changed: Retry the contrast cap (35 -> 25) on top of the size prior
why tried: E13 failed alone; the size prior removes the tiny distractors so a moderate cap might now help.

what changed: Retry the contrast cap (35 -> 15) on top of the size prior
why tried: Same question as E17 with the stronger cap.

what changed: Stronger size reward (w_size 1.0 -> 1.5)
why tried: Size prior gave the largest Phase 2b gain, so test whether pushing it further helps (risk: preferring an oversized ellipse).
